Offload запускает на вашем компьютере ло: Offload runs a local coding model on your computer and connects it to Claude Code and other IDEs. The cloud model delegates routine subtasks to it — reading files, summarizing logs, reviews, simple edits — and spends fewer tokens.
llama.cpp — сервер для запуска моделей (: llama.cpp — a server for running models (a build for your GPU).
Локальная модель для программирования (ф: A local coding model (a GGUF file, from a few to tens of gigabytes).
OpenCode — агент, с которым модель выпол: OpenCode — an agent that lets the model perform multi-step tasks (optional).

OpenCode — агент для программирования. С: OpenCode is a coding agent. With it, the local model can perform multi-step tasks: read the files it needs, make consistent edits across several of them and check the result with a build or tests. Without OpenCode, edits are made only by rewriting files directly.
